evidence_set: The pilot ran from April to July 2019 at ten sites already offering on-site drug checking with fentanyl strips. Take-home strips were used in varied settings, a sheet possibly naming more than one: at home, including private residences, tents and single-room occupancy hotels, on 184 sheets (54.8%), in alleys and streets on 74 (22.0%) and at overdose prevention or supervised consumption sites on 97 (28.9%).
